cards.name: Deepwood Steward
cards.text: Reaction: After you marshal Deepwood Steward, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a The North or out-of-faction location, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Wedding at the Wall
cards.text: Shadow (0). Reaction: After you win a [power] challenge as the attacking player, choose and stand 2 characters you control with the R'hllor or Wildling trait.
cards.flavor: "What fire joins, none may put asunder" - Melisandre

cards.name: Kingsmoot Claimant
cards.text: While Kingsmoot Claimant is attacking an opponent who does not control a King character, it gains the King trait and renown.
cards.flavor: "Beneath the bones of Nagga every captain stands as equal." - The Reader

cards.name: Captain of the Iron Fleet
cards.text: Ironborn character you control only. Attached character gains the Captain trait. Action: During a [military] or [power] challenge, kneel Captain of the Iron Fleet and a Warship location to have attached character contribute its STR to your side this challenge.

cards.name: Orton Merryweather
cards.text: Each gold in your gold pool contributes an additional 1 STR towards your total for dominance. Interrupt: When dominance is determined, if you have not lost an [intrigue] challenge this round, gain 2 gold.

cards.name: Jeweled Tiara
cards.text: Lady character only. Attached character gains the Queen trait. Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge in which attached character is participating, kneel Jeweled Tiara to discard 1 card at random from the losing opponent's hand. (3 cards instead if you won by 10 or more STR.)

cards.name: Nymella Toland
cards.text: Action: Choose a character that is attacking or defending alone, and remove it from the challenge. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "...Lady Jordayne has arranged games in his honor. When he reaches Ghost Hill he will find Lady Toland intent on outdoing her." - Doran Martell

cards.name: Godsgrace
cards.text: Reaction: After a [martell] character you control gains power, if there is a Summer plot card revealed, kneel Godsgrace to have that character gain 1 power.

cards.name: Alys Karstark
cards.text: Reaction: After Alys Karstark stands, choose another Wildling character you control and have it gain 1 power. Then, if that character was Sigorn, draw 1 card. (Limit twice per round.)
cards.flavor: "Alys, do you swear to share your fire with Sigorn, and warm him when the night is dark and full of terrors?" - Melisandre

cards.name: Skirling Pass
cards.text: While Skirling Pass is standing, each non-Wildling character loses stealth.
cards.flavor: The wind cut like a knife up here, and shrilled in the night like a mother mourning her slain children.

cards.name: Arnolf Karstark
cards.text: Reaction: After a character or location is sacrificed, stand Arnolf Karstark. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "March, I said, and before the moon can turn, we'll all be bathing in the blood of Freys and Boltons."

cards.name: Lord of Winterfell
cards.text: [stark] Lord character only. While there is a Winter plot card revealed, attached character gains insight. Reaction: After you win a challenge in which you control a participating loyal character, kneel Lord of Winterfell to have attached character gain 1 power.

cards.name: Sons of the Harpy
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After Sons of the Harpy comes out of shadows, choose a participating character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -2 STR.
cards.flavor: The Sons of the Harpy did their butchery by night, and over each kill they left their mark.

cards.name: Blood of Valyria
cards.text:
Unique [targaryen] character only.
Attached character's STR cannot be reduced by card effects.
Attached character gains insight during [power] challenges.
cards.flavor: The line must be kept pure, Viserys had told her a thousand times.

cards.name: Paxter Redwyne
cards.text: Renown. Shadow (5). Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Paxter Redwyne is participating, choose a location you own and return it to your hand. (You may place it in shadows instead if it has the Warship trait.) (Limit twice per phase.)

cards.name: Morningstar
cards.text: Character you control only. Reaction: After you win a [military] challenge in which attached character is participating, kneel Morningstar to stand attached character and remove it from the challenge.

cards.name: Sigorn
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a [military] challenge in which Sigorn is attacking, choose and stand another Wildling character you control. Then, if that character was Alys Karstark, stand Sigorn.
cards.flavor: "Sigorn, will you share your fire with Alys, and warm her when the night is dark and full of terrors?"" - Melisandre

cards.name: Shadowskin Cloak
cards.text: Shadow (0). Attached character gains stealth. Forced Interrupt: When the challenges phase ends, return Shadowskin Cloak to your hand.
cards.flavor: "My cloak, the shadowskin you took from me for safekeeping." - Tyrion Lannister

cards.name: Into the Lists
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player may choose and kneel a non-Army character they control with a [military] icon. Then, if exactly 1 character has the highest STR among characters knelt this way, it gains 2 power.

cards.name: Searching the Archives
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose up to 3 cards in your hand and place them facedown under your agenda. Then, draw that many cards.
